newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney, Schmalbach to merge units.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney, Schmalbach to merge units.

text.p: French metals group Pechiney SA said on Monday it had finalised a merger of its metal packaging activities with those of Germany's Schmalbach-Lubeca AG in a venture that also brings in Doughty Hanson & Co of Britain.
The merger, provisionally agreed last November, will go ahead at the beginning of May subject to regulatory approval, Pechiney said in a statement.
The merged business will have turnover above seven billion francs from 35 factories spread across 12 countries, it said.

Schmalbach-Lubeca, a subsidiary of German industrial group Viag AG, said in November it had signed a letter of intent with Pechiney for the merger of their metal packaging activities but that further talks were needed.
Private fund manager Doughty Hanson & Co will hold a majority stake in the new venture to be called Impress Metal Packaging, Pechiney said on Monday, without giving a figure.
Pechiney and Schmalbach will hold 20 percent each, it said.
The merged company will have 7,850 staff.
